f1-circuits — bacinger/f1-circuits, fetched 2026-09-18 from
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bacinger/f1-circuits/master/f1-circuits.geojson
and vendored verbatim as /vendor/f1-circuits.json. The extension is .json and not .geojson
because nginx's mime map knows the first and not the second; the bytes are unchanged.

The geometry is traced from OpenStreetMap. OpenStreetMap is already credited on every map that
draws this file, by the basemap's own attribution control, so it is not credited a second time
in the page.
